references.text: The priest receives the offering and presents it before the Lord at the altar, a parallel to the priest's role in receiving the basket from the worshiper.
The firstfruits offering was to be brought to the priest who would wave it before the Lord, corresponding to the action with the basket in Deuteronomy.
The priest shall wave the offerings before the Lord; they are holy to the Lord and belong to the priest.
The firstfruits of all that is given to the Lord shall belong to the priests, confirming the priest's role in receiving the firstfruits offering.
The context for the verse: the firstfruits are placed in a basket and brought to the place the Lord chooses.
The worshiper sets the gift down before the Lord and worships, completing the ritual that begins in verse 4.
